intro:
Just 5 seconds. Spot the culprit.
One person in the crowd is moving wrong — catch them.
description:
A park, a station, a market, a beach — somewhere in this peaceful scene, a culprit is hiding.

"They were right in front of me..."
"By the time I noticed, they were gone."
Once the culprit starts moving, you only have 5 seconds.

This game is a snap-judgment puzzle where you tap the single culprit hiding in a crowded scene.
Pickpockets, shoplifters, burglars, bag thieves, snatchers, bike thieves —
Can you spot the "one person trying to hide something" in 5 seconds?

How to play is simple.
・When the image appears, observe within 5 seconds
・Tap the person you think is the culprit
・The answer and the crime are revealed

The thrill of "I knew it was that one!" and the frustration of "Let me see it again!"
50 scenes across parks, markets, beaches, museums, queues, neighborhoods, and more.

Quick rounds make it perfect for spare moments.
Observation and reflex — both put to the test in this brain-training game for adults.

So, can you spot the culprit in 5 seconds?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
